methodology: Every table row carries a source link to an official site. Values that could not be confirmed from an official source are left blank and flagged 'unverified'. No values were inferred or filled in.

irregularities_flagged.detail: The task specifies 'subway or bus'. Las Vegas has no underground metro/subway (confirmed 2026). The 1-hour criterion is evaluated using the RTC Deuce bus + Las Vegas Monorail.

irregularities_flagged.item: Michelin returned to Las Vegas in 2026
